The Reactivity Series: does every metal give hydrogen with dilute acid? Copper doesn't. Class 10 Chemistry, Metals and Non-metals.

• Metals listed by decreasing reactivity: potassium at the top, gold at the bottom
• Iron is above copper, so it displaces copper from copper sulphate
• Metals above hydrogen displace hydrogen from dilute acids, those below cannot
• With dilute HCl: Mg > Al > Zn > Fe, and copper does not react
